Compassionate Care in the Fight Against Cancer

Cancer can affect pets at any stage of life, presenting in many forms and often progressing silently before symptoms appear. Early detection and timely intervention can make a meaningful difference in treatment success and quality of life.

Our Oncology service provides comprehensive evaluation and management of cancer through advanced diagnostics and individualised treatment plans. We work closely with pet families throughout the journey, offering guidance and support at every step of care.

The department is powered by The Cancer Vet, India’s first designated veterinary oncology practice, and is led and supervised by Dr. Noopur Desai - an American-trained and board-certified oncologist,DACVR (R. Oncology).

Oncology consultations and second opinions

Oncology consultations and second opinions

Chemotherapy and medical oncology

Radiation therapy, planned and supervised by a board-certified veterinarian and oncologist
Noopur Desai worked as an Assistant Professor of Oncology at TheOhio State University. One of the main reasons she moved back to India was to bring home what she learned over the years in the US and enhance cancer care for pets in India. # Does your dog have cancer? Don't lose heart

  * ### Does your dog have cancer? Don't lose heart

Image

Jun 24,2015 Posted By : Santosh Andhale

Tata Memorial Centre in Kharghar offers chemotherapy and radiotherapy for canines; it's the only such unit in the country

Image: Dog Cancer

###### Snowy (left) is undergoing radiation for oral cancer; canine activist Shwetali Mulik, who had taken her Labrador to the Kharghar facility, has been creating awareness

 

Angela Mah's face beamed with joy when she saw her dog Snowy responding to treatment. It was Snowy's sixth radiation session. You heard it right. The dog was receiving cancer care.

In what could bring a smile on the face of hundreds of dog owners, cancer-afflicted canines can be treated at the the Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research & Education in Cancer (ACTREC), Tata Memorial Centre, at Kharghar in Navi Mumbai. It is the only such facility in the country.

Experts say cancer afflicts a large number dogs and majority of them die untreated as most of city veterinary doctors are unaware of the availability of treatment in India.

Singaporean Angela, employed with a multinational firm, shifted base to Mumbai last year and brought Snowy with her. Three months ago, she notice a small growth on the left side of the dog's neck. Angela was devastated when tests revealed that Snowy had oral cancer.

After spending some sleepless nights, she came across a vet who advised her to consult Dr Pradip Chaudhari, a veterinary oncologist at ACTREC. "Initially, I didn't know what to do. It seems many vets are clueless about the availability of radiation therapy here. In the absence of awareness, I believe, many pet owners watch with pain their beloved pets losing the battle," said Angela.

The 47-year-old executive said the radiation cycles have helped Snowy in many ways in the past six weeks. "Earlier, she wouldn't eat properly, which is not the case now. Her treatment is still on and I'm hoping for the best."

Cancer care for dogs at ACTREC costs between Rs40,000 and Rs60,000 depending on treatment cycles such as chemotherapy or radiation. Last year, the centre treated nearly 150 dogs.

# Oncology & Tumour Removal

## Advanced Cancer Care With Compassion

At The Jupiter Pet Hospital, we provide comprehensive cancer diagnostics and tumour removal surgeries to improve survival, comfort, and overall quality of life for pets. From early screening to advanced surgical treatment, every step is done with accuracy, safety, and compassionate handling.

## Tumour & Cancer Conditions We Treat:

  * Skin tumours (benign & malignant)
  * Mammary tumours
  * Oral & jaw tumours
  * Bone cancers (osteosarcoma)
  * Abdominal masses
  * Lymphoma & lymph node enlargement
  * Anal gland tumours
  * Nasal & lung tumours


## When to Suspect a Tumour in Your Pet:

  * New lumps or swelling on the body
  * Rapidly growing or changing lumps
  * Wounds that don’t heal
  * Unexplained weight loss
  * Loss of appetite
  * Bleeding from mouth/nose
  * Difficulty walking or limping
  * Chronic vomiting or diarrhoea
  * Fatigue and reduced activity

“Focused on better outcomes with gentle, expert care.”

## Accurate diagnosis is the foundation of successful cancer treatment.

We follow a meticulous, evidence-based evaluation process to identify the tumour type, assess its spread, and plan the safest, most effective treatment for your pet.

Image: Veterinary surgeon performing orthopaedic surgery at The Jupiter Pet Hospital Hyderabad

### Our Diagnostic Approach:

### Physical Examination & History

Detailed evaluation to understand the nature and behaviour of the mass.

### Fine Needle Aspiration (FNA)

Quick and minimally invasive cell sampling.

### Biopsy (Incisional / Excisional)

Required for definitive diagnosis & grading.

### Advanced Imaging

Ultrasound, Digital X-ray, & 2D EchoDoppler studies.Used to assess spread (metastasis) and plan surgery safely.

### Blood Work & Organ Function Tests

Ensures safe anaesthesia and identifies treatment risks.

## Specialised Treatment Options We Provide:

## Medical Oncology

  * Stabilisation
  * Pain management
  * Supportive therapy
  * Follow-up monitoring

## Surgical Oncology & Tumour Removal

  * Safe anaesthesia with monitoring
  * Soft tissue and bone tumour removal
  * Reconstructive surgery when needed

## Chemotherapy (When Indicated)

  * Protocol-based, safe, and personalised—aimed at prolonging quality life, not causing discomfort.

“Every treatment plan is tailored to give your pet the safest, most effective path to recovery.”

Image: Veterinary surgeon performing orthopaedic surgery at The Jupiter Pet Hospital Hyderabad

## Understanding Cancer & Tumours in Pets

  * Early detection greatly improves recovery chances.
  * Not all tumours are cancerous, but all lumps should be checked.
  * Fast-growing or changing lumps need immediate evaluation.
  * Advanced imaging helps identify spread and plan safe treatment.
  * Timely tumour removal can significantly extend quality of life.

## Recovery & Post-Surgery Care

  * Pain control based on tumour type
  * Regular wound checks
  * Monitoring for recurrence
  * Follow-up imaging when required
  * Diet and lifestyle recommendations

## Why Choose Jupiter Pet Hospital for Cancer Care?

### Evidence-based treatment protocols

### High-precision diagnostic imaging

### Safe anaesthesia with real-time monitoring

### Dedicated follow-up and long-term care planning

### Experienced oncology & soft-tissue surgeons

## Commonly Asked Questions

### Is every lump cancerous?

No. Many lumps are benign, but only testing can confirm.

### Does tumour removal cure cancer?

Depends on the tumour type—some are fully curable with surgery, others may need additional therapy.

### Is chemotherapy safe for pets?

Yes. Veterinary chemotherapy uses mild, pet-safe dosing focused on quality of life.

### How quickly should I act if I find a lump?

Immediately. Early diagnosis greatly improves outcomes.

# Our Mission

At The Cancer Vet, our mission is to provide world-class veterinary oncology services in India, offering hope and compassionate care to pets and their families facing a cancer diagnosis. We are dedicated to advancing the field of veterinary oncology through ongoing research, education, and the development of an international residency program to train the next generation of veterinary oncologists. Our goal is to enhance the quality of life for pets battling cancer and empower pet owners with knowledge and support during this challenging journey.

# Our Values

### Hope

We believe in the power of hope. Despite the challenges a cancer diagnosis may bring, we are committed to exploring all possible treatment options and providing a beacon of hope for pets and their families.

### Compassion

We understand that pets are cherished members of the family. That's why we approach every case with deep compassion, empathy, and understanding, providing a supportive and caring environment for both pets and their owners.
